# WeirdFlex

> WeirdFlex is an independent playable studio making browser games, interactive brand campaigns, and music-driven experiences.

Website: https://weirdflex.online/
Language: English

## What we do
- Playable brand experiences and promotional games
- Browser-based games and interactive experiments
- Music-led interactive experiences
